title: We making modules!
author: wit1200
selftext: Customize your spacecraft to match your playstyle — focus on combat, or lean into storage and resource gathering.

comments.author: kilographix
comments.body: This is honestly inspirational, thanks for continuing to post your progress!

replies.author: wit1200
replies.body: Thank you for the kind words!

comments.author: caliginous4
comments.body:
Hey I would really love to hear about your process for ship lighting. 
This looks awesome.

replies.author: wit1200
replies.body: Thank you!!! simple directional light source + normal maps <3

replies.author: caliginous4
replies.body:
Did you hand author the normal maps? I've been trying to come up with a workflow for making normal maps. Couple issues I have is removing baked in shading, and getting a good normal map. Closest workflow I have is using trellis.2 to make a 3d asset of a ship then getting a normal map from that but it's not perfect by any means. I'm thinking of just reverting to hand authored and colored ships and normal maps. 

I've also been working on a 2d space game that looks very similar to yours - target seeking missiles, erodable ships, etc. lots of overlap for sure, though I plan for mine to be story driven single player and looks like yours is focused on multiplayer.
